- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pioneering bands of Black Metal include Mayhem, Burzum, and Darkthrone.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nu-Metal emerged in the late 1990s, characterized by a fusion of heavy metal with hip hop, funk, and alternative rock.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pioneering bands of Nu-Metal include Korn, Limp Bizkit, and Linkin Park.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Metalcore emerged in the early 2000s, characterized by a fusion of heavy metal and hardcore punk, featuring elements of melody and clean vocals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pioneering bands of Metalcore include Killswitch Engage, Atreyu, and Underoath.
